steps.note: Cream is added to bring the fat up; US law asks for at least 33 % milk fat in the cheese.
The acid makes the proteins lose their charge and the milk coagulates into a curd.
It is heated to stop the culture once the curd has formed.
The whey is removed and the curd formed into a mass.
Gums keep water from separating and extend shelf life.

sources.text: The order of cream, homogenising, souring at about 22 °C, heating, whey removal and gums is from this article; its heating range is uncited there, so none is given.
